# Home Project Planner (Newton, MA)

> Free, independent planning tool that helps Newton, Massachusetts homeowners see which permits, zoning limits, historic reviews, and stormwater rules may apply to a home project before they talk to the City. Not affiliated with the City of Newton; results are preliminary and point to official sources for confirmation.

The planner asks guided questions about a project (additions, decks, bathrooms, kitchens, basements, ADUs, exterior and site work) and returns a source-cited preliminary assessment. Uncertain items are marked as needing City confirmation rather than guessed.

## Pages

- [Home Project Planner](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/): Start a free guided project assessment.
- [Planning guides](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/): Plain-language guides for Newton home projects.

## Guides

- [Do I need a permit for an addition?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/do-i-need-a-permit-for-an-addition/): Permits and zoning checks for home additions.
- [Do I need a permit for a deck?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/do-i-need-a-permit-for-a-deck/): When decks need building permits and setback review.
- [Building permit vs. zoning approval](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/building-permit-vs-zoning-approval/): How the two approvals differ.
- [How much can I build on my lot?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/how-much-can-i-build-on-my-lot/): Lot coverage, setbacks, and floor area basics.
- [Historic home renovation](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/historic-home-renovation/): Historic district and demolition review considerations.
- [Stormwater and flood zone projects](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/stormwater-and-flood-zone-home-projects/): Drainage and floodplain considerations.
- [Questions before starting a home project](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/questions-before-starting-a-home-project/): A checklist before you hire or apply.
- [Are ADUs allowed in Massachusetts?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/are-adus-allowed-in-massachusetts/): Massachusetts' 2024 Affordable Homes Act protects one accessory dwelling unit on single-family lots. What the law (M.G.L. c.40A §3) and state guidance say.
- [Can a homeowner do electrical, plumbing or gas work in Newton, MA?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/electrical-plumbing-gas-permits-newton-homeowners/): What Newton and Massachusetts say about who can pull electrical, plumbing and gas permits, which minor plumbing repairs need no permit, and water heater permits.
- [How big can an ADU be in Massachusetts?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/how-big-can-an-adu-be-in-massachusetts/): The Massachusetts ADU size cap: half the main home's gross floor area or 900 sq ft, whichever is smaller. Plus how floor area is counted, and Newton's local limits.
- [How do I close an open permit in Newton, MA?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/how-to-close-an-open-permit-in-newton/): Old Newton permits do not close on their own. What the City says about closing them, who may call, and why to hold final payment until closure.
- [How do I find my zoning district in Newton, MA?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/how-to-find-your-newton-zoning-district/): Where to look up your Newton zoning district: the City's interactive zoning map and GIS Browser, and what the ordinance says about the Official Zoning Map.
- [How do I get a building permit in Newton, MA?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/how-to-get-a-building-permit-in-newton-ma/): Step-by-step: how Newton building permits are applied for online, what the City checklist asks for, how fees are calculated, and the inspections that follow.
- [What are the ADU rules in Newton, MA?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/newton-adu-rules/): Newton accessory dwelling unit rules from Ord. Sec. 6.7.1: one per lot, no extra parking, 30-day minimum rentals, and size limits for internal and detached ADUs.
- [How tall can a house be in Newton, MA?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/newton-building-height-limits/): Newton's maximum house heights: 36 feet sloped roof, 30 feet flat roof, 2.5 stories (3 by special permit), and how height is measured.
- [How do building inspections work in Newton, MA?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/newton-building-inspections/): How to schedule a Newton building inspection, the call-before-8-AM rule, and what must be ready at each stage from excavation to final.
- [What is Newton's demolition delay, and does it apply to my house?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/newton-demolition-delay/): Newton Historical Commission demolition review: buildings 50+ years old (including garages and sheds), partial demolition, 12- and 18-month delays, and waivers.
- [Do new homes and renovations in Newton have to be all-electric?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/newton-energy-code-all-electric-rules/): Newton's Specialized Energy Code (since 2024) and fossil-fuel-free ordinance: electrified heating, cooling, cooking and drying for new builds and major renovations.
- [What is the floor area ratio (FAR) limit in Newton, MA?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/newton-floor-area-ratio-far/): How Newton defines FAR, the maximum FAR by lot size for SR and MR districts (Ord. Sec. 3.1.9 and 3.2.11), and the City's FAR calculator.
- [What needs approval in a Newton local historic district?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/newton-local-historic-district-review/): In a Newton local historic district, exterior changes, including hardscaping, need Historic District Commission review. How the certificates work.
- [What is the maximum lot coverage in Newton, MA?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/newton-lot-coverage-limits/): Newton's maximum lot coverage percentages for SR1–SR3 and MR1–MR4 from Ord. Sec. 3.1.3 and 3.2.3, by lot creation date.
- [How do I apply for and track a permit on Newton's online portal?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/newton-permit-portal-opengov/): How Newton's online permitting works: the OpenGov account, starting an application, public record search by address, and checking permits are closed.
- [What are Newton's SR and MR zoning districts?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/newton-residential-zoning-districts-explained/): What Newton's Single Residence (SR1–SR3) and Multi-Residence (MR1–MR4) districts are and which housing types the ordinance allows in each.
- [What is the difference between a special permit and a variance in Newton?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/newton-special-permits-and-variances/): Who grants special permits and variances in Newton, the two-thirds City Council vote, site plan approval, and the legal tests for a variance.
- [Do I need a permit to cut down a tree in Newton, MA?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/newton-tree-preservation-ordinance/): Newton's Tree Preservation Ordinance (Ch. 21): which trees are protected (6 inches DBH and up), when a tree permit is needed, and replacement rules.
- [What are the zoning setbacks in Newton, MA?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/newton-zoning-setbacks/): Newton's minimum front, side and rear setbacks for SR and MR districts from Ord. Sec. 3.1.3 and 3.2.3, including the December 7, 1953 lot-date split.
- [Do I need a permit for solar panels in Newton, MA?](https://home-project-planner-mvp.vercel.app/guides/solar-panel-permit-newton-ma/): Newton's fee schedule lists building permits for solar panels, with and without structural work, plus a separate electrical permit for solar.
